issue.title: Allow partial pool updates with update_mask

repository.name: airflow
repository.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

issue.body:
A client can't change just the slots of a pool. `PATCH /api/v2/pools/{pool_name}?update_mask=slots` with `{"slots": 8}` returns 422 because the pool name and `include_deferred` are still required. A bulk update with the same mask fails too, and only `default_pool` honours the mask. So clients resend `include_deferred` every time, and `airflowctl pools update --pool etl --slots 16` sends false, which turns deferred slots off on a pool that had them on.

With this change, a PATCH or bulk update with a mask needs only the masked fields and keeps the rest. Masked fields are still validated (`{"slots": null}` is still a 422), and a PATCH without a mask still needs the full body.

The service validated the body against the full pool schema before applying the mask. Now it validates only the fields it will write and takes the other required ones from the stored pool.

closes: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/73768
related: https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/71220 edits the same validation block. They are compatible; the second to merge needs a rebase there.

### Testing Done

The reproducer below drives a real API server (SQLite, simple auth manager) run with `airflow` from `uv sync --project airflow-core`, once at main 18fe1c6 and once at this branch.

Before, main at 18fe1c6:

```

$ airflow version   # the server
3.4.0

$ curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:64263/api/v2/pools -d '{"name": "etl", "slots": 4, "description": "nightly loads", "include_deferred": true}'
{"name":"etl","slots":4,"description":"nightly loads","include_deferred":true,"occupied_slots":0,"running_slots":0,"queued_slots":0,"scheduled_slots":0,"open_slots":4,"deferred_slots":0,"team_name":null}
HTTP 201

$ curl -X PATCH 'http://127.0.0.1:64263/api/v2/pools/etl?update_mask=slots' -d '{"slots": 8}'
{"detail":[{"type":"missing","loc":["pool"],"msg":"Field required","input":{"slots":8},"url":"https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.13/v/missing"},{"type":"missing","loc":["include_deferred"],"msg":"Field required","input":{"slots":8},"url":"https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.13/v/missing"}]}
HTTP 422

$ curl -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:64263/api/v2/pools -d '{"actions": [{"action": "update", "entities": [{"name": "etl", "slots": 12}], "update_mask": ["slots"]}]}'
{"detail":[{"type":"missing","loc":["include_deferred"],"msg":"Field required","input":{"slots":12,"pool":"etl"},"url":"https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.13/v/missing"}]}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Partial pool PATCH requests with and without update_mask against a real Airflow API server (SQLite, simple auth manager).
# Usage: pool-mask-e2e.sh <airflow executable for the server>
set -u
AIRFLOW=${1:?usage: pool-mask-e2e.sh <airflow>}
PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])')
URL="http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"
SERVER_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
SERVER_ENV=(
  AIRFLOW_HOME="$SERVER_HOME"
  AIRFLOW__CORE__LOAD_EXAMPLES=False
  AIRFLOW__CORE__SIMPLE_AUTH_MANAGER_USERS=admin:admin
)
say() { printf '\n$ %s\n' "$1"; }

env "${SERVER_ENV[@]}" "$AIRFLOW" db migrate > "$SERVER_HOME/setup.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$SERVER_HOME/setup.log"; exit 1; }
env "${SERVER_ENV[@]}" "$AIRFLOW" api-server --port "$PORT" --workers 1 > "$SERVER_HOME/api-server.log" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
trap 'kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$SERVER_HOME"' EXIT
PASSWORDS="$SERVER_HOME/simple_auth_manager_passwords.json.generated"
for _ in $(seq 90); do
  curl -sf "$URL/api/v2/monitor/health" > /dev/null && [ -s "$PASSWORDS" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
PASSWORD=$(python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["admin"])' "$PASSWORDS")
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "$URL/auth/token" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"username\": \"admin\", \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\"}" | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])')
api() { curl -s -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' "$@"; }

say 'airflow version   # the server'
env "${SERVER_ENV[@]}" "$AIRFLOW" version 2> /dev/null

say "curl -X POST $URL/api/v2/pools -d '$CREATE'"
api -X POST "$URL/api/v2/pools" -d "$CREATE"

say "curl -X PATCH '$URL/api/v2/pools/etl?update_mask=slots' -d '{\"slots\": 8}'"
api -X PATCH "$URL/api/v2/pools/etl?update_mask=slots" -d '{"slots": 8}'

BULK='{"actions": [{"action": "update", "entities": [{"name": "etl", "slots": 12}], "update_mask": ["slots"]}]}'
say "curl -X PATCH $URL/api/v2/pools -d '$BULK'"

say "curl $URL/api/v2/pools/etl"

say "curl -X PATCH '$URL/api/v2/pools/etl?update_mask=slots' -d '{\"slots\": null}'   # a masked field is still validated"
api -X PATCH "$URL/api/v2/pools/etl?update_mask=slots" -d '{"slots": null}'

say "curl -X PATCH $URL/api/v2/pools/etl -d '{\"slots\": 8}'   # without update_mask the full body is still required"
